cases.name: manual_latin_even_16/sparse-congruence
cases.evidence: All recipes consume one unit each of R, C and S and produce one GOAL. Requesting n with each resource stocked once saturates all three families. Each recipe has R_index+C_index-S_index divisible by n, but the saturated RHS n*(n-1)/2 is not divisible by even n. Independent modular obstruction; every emitted CGSE certificate is separately replayed.
